content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PMMMH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PMMMH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital is scheduled for 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital has announced a total of 11 vacancies for the Senior Resident positions across various specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by MCI and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council. Additionally, they should not have completed three years of Senior Residency.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules for Persons with Disabilities (PwD).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary as per Level-11 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PMMMH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these Senior Resident positions is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to appear directly at the interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Which specialties have vacancies for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for Senior Residents in Radiology, Anesthesia, Microbiology, Obs & Gynae, Paediatrics, Medicine, and Orthopedics.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, New Delhi - 110017.
